observedFacts.fact: EmitStreamingPipeline invokes the actual first user stream body with its complete source argument and a continuation sink. Intermediate stages retain their declaration bodies and additional arguments.

EmitYield enters the caller callback lexical scope, binds actual yielded inputs, computes the callback result, preserves lexical loop authority and restores producer locals. EmitStreamValue dispatches the produced value to the next stage or final consumer.
isUserBlockFunction explicitly excludes stream flag64 and native flag128. materializeUserBlockCallbacks uses this predicate, so ordinary source-body copying does not expand project.

The first ordinary stream stage uses stageParts.source0/source1; only flatMap flag3 sets a single receiver. pipelineStatus defaults to Range0 and is changed only for single receiver or runtime Stream/EventStream types.
Range status0 unconditionally writes i32 source0 and source1 as bounds. The failed LLVM stores array alias v7 into an i32 slot and requests missing upper bound -1.
V007 observes the invalid -1 operand. Substituting a bound/default or suppressing this guard would hide the incorrect producer classification, not execute the declared user stream body.

implementationRequirements: Preserve the full source argument and execute the declaration body; do not approximate arbitrary user streams as range/array mapping.
Reuse the existing relocatable generic body and callback scope machinery with explicit stream continuation ownership.
Bind yield callback inputs and results before emit; evaluate additional arguments once and preserve state bindings.
Preserve caller return, callback lexical break/continue, producer stop/cancellation, ownership and cleanup.
Support chained user stream stages and runtime producers without function-name special cases; keep intrinsic/native boundaries distinct.
rejectedShortcuts: array-only loop replacing the actual user function body
mark explicit unsupported diagnostics as feature completion
repeat full Native diagnostics after exhausted cumulative budget
